  "content": """"Small text helpers."""

import re


def slugify(title):
    """Return a URL slug: lower-case words of letters and digits, joined by single hyphens.

    slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
    """
    words = re.split(r"\s+", title.strip())
    return "-".join(words)
